en: Black‑and‑white aerial view of a lakeside residential suburb bordered by dense coniferous forest. Small detached houses with gabled roofs are spread out along curving streets, each with gardens or small plots of land. A shoreline with trees and dark water appears in the lower left, while forest stretches along the top edge of the image. No visible text appears on the front.
